ValidationRule.description: Ticket ref must look like ABC-123, and the slug must be lowercase, space-free, not end with '-' and begin with the ticket prefix.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Ticket_Ref__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Slug__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(Ticket_Ref__c, '[A-Z]{2,5}-[0-9]{1,7}')), NOT(BEGINS(Slug__c, LOWER(LEFT(Ticket_Ref__c, MAX(0, FIND('-', Ticket_Ref__c) - 1))))), Slug__c <> LOWER(Slug__c), CONTAINS(Slug__c, ' '), RIGHT(Slug__c, 1) = '-' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Ticket Ref or Slug has an invalid shape.
